actions.description: Pipette already has a tip attached; hand positions pipette over blue rack/wells.
Tip is inserted into/held in wells or small tubes in the blue rack, consistent with aspirating or dispensing.
Tip is lifted and moved away from the wells toward the front/side of the blue rack.
Tip appears to contact or rest against the exterior/front edge of the blue rack rather than being in a well.
Same tip is moved back over/into the blue rack wells.

reuse.evidence: Same tip is used within the blue rack, but the frames do not show whether different samples/reagents are involved.

surface.evidence: The pipette tip appears to touch the outside/front edge of the blue rack, a non-sample surface, and is then moved back toward the wells.

release.evidence: No tip drop, ejection, or unexpected release is visible.

install.evidence: A tip is attached and appears seated normally; no wrong-size or loose fitting is visible.

output.overall_summary: The visible likely error is the tip contacting the exterior of the rack before continued use.
